class.name: Thespeon
class.brief_description: Synthesizes speech from a [ThespeonInput] with the installed Thespeon modules.
class.description: Loads character and language modules from the addon's [code]runtime-files[/code] directory and synthesizes speech with them, either to a WAV file or as a [ThespeonAudioStream] that plays while it is being synthesized. Models stay loaded in the node between calls. [b]Note:[/b] Every method except [method synthesize_stream] blocks the calling thread, so calling one from the main thread freezes the game until it finishes. Use [method preload_input] or [method preload_module] at a convenient moment, such as a loading screen, to keep the first synthesis fast. [codeblock] var input := ThespeonInput.new() input.set_character("MyCharacter") input.add_segment("Hello there!") var stream: ThespeonAudioStream = $Thespeon.synthesize_stream(input) $AudioStreamPlayer.stream = stream $AudioStreamPlayer.play() [/codeblock]

method.name: get_abi_version
method.description: Returns the ABI version of the loaded Thespeon runtime library.

method.name: get_emotions_for_character
method.description: Returns the emotions a character accepts, as an [Array] of [Dictionary]s with the keys [code]name[/code] and [code]guide[/code]. [param model] is a module identifier or a character name. A name selects the largest, then newest, matching module, narrowed by [param module_type] and [param module_version] when they are not empty. Returns an empty [Array], and prints an error, when no module matches.

method.name: get_resident_bytes
method.description: Returns the number of bytes of memory held by the loaded modules.

method.name: is_input_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if everything [param input] needs is already loaded, meaning [method preload_input] would load nothing.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the character or language module [param module_identifier] is loaded. A character counts as loaded whatever languages it was preloaded with.

method.name: list_loaded
method.description: Returns the same as [method list_models], restricted to the modules that are currently loaded, and without the [code]problems[/code] key.

method.name: list_models
method.description: Returns the installed modules as a [Dictionary] with the keys: - [code]characterModules[/code]: an [Array] of [Dictionary]s with [code]identifier[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]moduleType[/code], [code]version[/code], [code]languages[/code] and [code]emotionCount[/code]. Use [method get_emotions_for_character] for the emotions themselves. - [code]languageModules[/code]: an [Array] of [Dictionary]s with [code]identifier[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]version[/code] and [code]languages[/code]. - [code]problems[/code]: a [PackedStringArray] describing any module config that could not be read.

method.name: preload_input
method.description: Loads the character and languages [param input] selects, as [method preload_module] does.

method.name: preload_module
method.description: Loads a character module ahead of its first synthesis. If [param warmup] is [code]true[/code], also runs a throwaway synthesis so that the first real one reaches steady-state latency.

method.name: refresh
method.description: Re-reads the installed modules. Call it after [ThespeonImporter] has imported or deleted modules.

method.name: synthesize_stream
method.description: Starts synthesizing [param input] on a worker thread and returns at once. The returned [ThespeonAudioStream] plays as audio arrives. The stream's signals are emitted on the main thread, no earlier than the next idle frame, so connecting to them right after this call misses nothing. [param input] is copied, so it may be changed or reused straight away. Freeing this node, or the stream, cancels the synthesis. Returns [code]null[/code], and prints an error, if [param input] is invalid.

method.name: synthesize_wav
method.description: Synthesizes [param input] and writes it as a WAV file to [param output_path], which may be a [code]res://[/code] or [code]user://[/code] path. Blocks until the file is written.

method.name: unload_input
method.description: Unloads the character and languages [param input] selects, as [method unload_module] does.

method.name: unload_module
method.description: Unloads a module loaded by [method preload_module] or by a synthesis, freeing its memory.

method.name: validate_input
method.description: Returns [constant OK] if synthesis would accept [param input], including every emotion it names being one the character supports. No model is run, so a word the language module cannot pronounce is not caught.
